Regression for the private_key rule itself, which had no fixture at all - that is how it stayed broken in the bash port: its pattern starts with '-----', so `grep -Pq "$pattern"` without `--` made grep read it as an option (exit 2, stderr discarded, read as no-match). Header only, no key material.
text:
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
MIIEowIBAAKCAQEAsyntheticfixtureNOTAREALKEY
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
